failure.message:
AssertionError: '3/4/0/1' not found in '\subsection{Fixed-game native runtime comparison}
This public packet retains 8 assigned rows for one authored quest (\texttt{sealed-lighthouse-v1}), with seed 20261024 and two repeats per selector/representation cell. System-endpoint successes are 4/8; observed native executions are 7. Host invocations are summed from actual receipts (25), and observed repairs sum to 2. Committed transitions total 6, of which unsafe are 2; semantic replay valid/invalid/NR is 3/4/1, while fresh-engine reexecution valid/invalid/NR is 3/4/1. Observed elapsed duration is n=7; 28.14/25.00 seconds (mean/median), and observed preparation duration is n=7; 2.43/2.00 seconds; unobserved values are NR, not zero.

The first row is retained as a harness JSON-serialization technical failure and is not attributed to GPT-6.1 capability. At least 1 GPT-6.1 ontology row(s) retain a response-timeout failure under the frozen 60-second bound. Models provide typed-intent proposals; the deterministic Python planner/checker and Godot commit retain authority. The table is therefore a technical observation for one quest, not an efficacy, superiority, noninferiority, general ontology-consistency, or player-benefit claim. Semantic record-link replay is not fresh-engine reexecution. Provider identity/revision/cost and provider-request counts remain NR outside the public observation boundary.
'
